src="data:image/svg+xml;charset=UTF-8,%0A%20%20%20%20%20%20%3Csvg%20xmlns%3D%22http%3A%2F%2Fwww.w3.org%2F2000%2Fsvg%22%20width%3D%22160%22%20height%3D%22160%22%20viewBox%3D%220%200%20160%20160%22%3E%0A%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%3Cdefs%3E%0A%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%3ClinearGradient%20id%3D%22bg%22%20x1%3D%220%22%20y1%3D%220%22%20x2%3D%221%22%20y2%3D%221%22%3E%0A%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%3Cstop%20offset%3D%220%25%22%20stop-color%3D%22%239b111e%22%2F%3E%0A%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%3Cstop%20offset%3D%22100%25%22%20stop-color%3D%22%232b0005%22%2F%3E%0A%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%3C%2FlinearGradient%3E%0A%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%3CradialGradient%20id%3D%22ball%22%20cx%3D%2235%25%22%20cy%3D%2225%25%22%20r%3D%2270%25%22%3E%0A%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%3Cstop%20offset%3D%220%25%22%20stop-color%3D%22%23ffffff%22%2F%3E%0A%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%3Cstop%20offset%3D%2270%25%22%20stop-color%3D%22%23f1f1f1%22%2F%3E%0A%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%3Cstop%20offset%3D%22100%25%22%20stop-color%3D%22%23bcbcbc%22%2F%3E%0A%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%3C%2FradialGradient%3E%0A%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%3C%2Fdefs%3E%0A%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%3Crect%20width%3D%22160%22%20height%3D%22160%22%20rx%3D%2222%22%20fill%3D%22url(%23bg)%22%2F%3E%0A%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%3Ccircle%20cx%3D%2280%22%20cy%3D%2267%22%20r%3D%2243%22%20fill%3D%22url(%23ball)%22%20stroke%3D%22%23ffd700%22%20stroke-width%3D%225%22%2F%3E%0A%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%3Ccircle%20cx%3D%2280%22%20cy%3D%2267%22%20r%3D%2227%22%20fill%3D%22%239b111e%22%20opacity%3D%220.95%22%2F%3E%0A%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%3Ctext%20x%3D%2280%22%20y%3D%2278%22%20text-anchor%3D%22middle%22%20font-family%3D%22Arial%2C%20sans-serif%22%20font-size%3D%2228%22%20font-weight%3D%22bold%22%20fill%3D%22%23ffffff%22%3E4D%3C%2Ftext%3E%0A%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%3Ctext%20x%3D%2280%22%20y%3D%22132%22%20text-anchor%3D%22middle%22%20font-family%3D%22Arial%2C%20sans-serif%22%20font-size%3D%2212%22%20font-weight%3D%22bold%22%20fill%3D%22%23ffffff%22%3EOREGON%3C%2Ftext%3E%0A%20%20%20%20%20%20%3C%2Fsvg%3E%0A%20%20%20%20" <style>
  .winner-board{
    width: 360px;
    max-width: 100%;
    height: 460px;
    margin: 20px auto;
    background: linear-gradient(180deg,#1b0d06,#2b1608,#130904);
    border: 1px solid rgba(255,215,120,.35);
    border-radius: 18px;
    box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.35);
    overflow: hidden;
    position: relative;
    font-family: Arial, sans-serif;
  }

  .winner-title{
    text-align: center;
    padding: 14px 12px;
    font-size: 18px;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: #ffd978;
    background: linear-gradient(90deg,#5a2f00,#8b4a00,#5a2f00);
    border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,215,120,.25);
    letter-spacing: .5px;
  }

  .wb-track{
    list-style: none;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 12px;
  }

  .wb-item{
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 12px;
    background: rgba(255,255,255,.05);
    border: 1px solid rgba(255,215,120,.14);
    border-radius: 14px;
    padding: 10px;
    margin-bottom: 10px;
    transition: .3s ease;
  }

  .wb-item.is-new{
    background: rgba(255,215,120,.12);
    border-color: rgba(255,215,120,.35);
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,215,120,.12), 0 0 18px rgba(255,200,80,.16);
  }

  .wb-thumb{
    width: 58px;

    object-fit: cover;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    background: #2d2d2d;
  }

  .wb-info{
    min-width: 0;
    flex: 1;
  }

  .wb-name{
    font-size: 14px;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: #ffffff;
    margin-bottom: 4px;
  }

  .wb-amount{
    font-size: 16px;
    font-weight: 800;
    color: #ffd978;
    margin-bottom: 4px;
  }

  .wb-game{
    font-size: 12px;
    color: #d7d7d7;
    line-height: 1.35;
  }

  .wb-type{
    font-size: 11px;
    color: #ffb347;
    margin-top: 3px;
    font-weight: 700;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: .3px;
  }

  .wb-coin{
    position: absolute;
    width: 12px;
    height: 12px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: radial-gradient(circle at 30% 30%, #fff4b0, #ffcc33 60%, #d48c00 100%);
    pointer-events: none;
    animation: coinFloat .9s ease forwards;
    opacity: .95;
  }

  @keyframes coinFloat{
    0%{
      transform: translate(0,0) scale(1);
      opacity: .95;
    }
    100%{
      transform: translate(var(--sx), -55px) scale(.4);
      opacity: 0;
    }
  }

<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
  function createLotteryImage(number, label, color1, color2) {
    const svg = `
      <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="160" height="160" viewBox="0 0 160 160">
        <defs>
          <linearGradient id="bg" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
            <stop offset="0%" stop-color="${color1}"/>
            <stop offset="100%" stop-color="${color2}"/>
          </linearGradient>
          <radialGradient id="ball" cx="35%" cy="25%" r="70%">
            <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#ffffff"/>
            <stop offset="70%" stop-color="#f1f1f1"/>
            <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#bcbcbc"/>
          </radialGradient>
        </defs>
        <rect width="160" height="160" rx="22" fill="url(#bg)"/>
        <circle cx="80" cy="67" r="43" fill="url(#ball)" stroke="#ffd700" stroke-width="5"/>
        <circle cx="80" cy="67" r="27" fill="${color1}" opacity="0.95"/>
        <text x="80" y="78" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="28" font-weight="bold" fill="#ffffff">${number}</text>
        <text x="80" y="132" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="bold" fill="#ffffff">${label}</text>
      </svg>
    `;
    return "data:image/svg+xml;charset=UTF-8," + encodeURIComponent(svg);
  }

  const IMG = {
    oregon: createLotteryImage("4D", "OREGON", "#9b111e", "#2b0005"),
    carolina: createLotteryImage("3D", "CAROLINA DAY", "#d89b00", "#6b3100"),
    kynders: createLotteryImage("4D", "KYNDERS", "#1c6dd0", "#081a45"),
    sgp: createLotteryImage("SGP", "TOGEL SGP", "#d20a2e", "#600011")
  };

  const rand = (a, b) => Math.floor(Math.random() * (b - a + 1)) + a;

  const formatIDR = n =>
    "IDR " + n.toLocaleString("id-ID", {
      minimumFractionDigits: 2,
      maximumFractionDigits: 2
    });

  const mask = name => {
    const s = name.toLowerCase();
    if (s.length <= 2) return s[0] + "*";
    return s.slice(0, 2) + "****" + s.slice(-1);
  };

  const markets = [
    { title: "Oregon Lottery", type: "Kemenangan 4D", img: IMG.oregon },
    { title: "Carolina Day", type: "Kemenangan 3D", img: IMG.carolina },
    { title: "Kynders Pools", type: "Kemenangan 4D", img: IMG.kynders },
    { title: "Togel SGP", type: "Kemenangan Singapore", img: IMG.sgp }
  ];

  const names = [
    "andika","rizky","fahri","dimas","wahyu","rangga","bayu","agung",
    "hendra","gunawan","rendy","ferdi","yusuf","alvin","rahmat",
    "amelia","siska","putri","cindy","dewi","fitri","maya","nadya","intan"
  ];

  function generateNumber() {
    return String(rand(0, 9999)).padStart(4, "0");
  }

  function winner() {
    const m = markets[rand(0, markets.length - 1)];
    const base = rand(500000, 7000000);
    const bonus = rand(0, 4) === 1 ? rand(1000000, 3500000) : rand(100000, 700000);
    const total = base + bonus;

    return {
      name: mask(names[rand(0, names.length - 1)]) + rand(0, 9),
      amount: total,
      market: m.title,
      type: m.type,
      number: generateNumber(),
      img: m.img
    };
  }

  const track = document.getElementById("wbTrack");
  const board = document.getElementById("winnerBoard");
  if (!track || !board) return;

  function renderItem(data) {
    const li = document.createElement("li");
    li.className = "wb-item";
    li.innerHTML = `
      <img class="wb-thumb" src="${data.img}" alt="${data.market}">
      <div class="wb-info">
        <div class="wb-name">${data.name}</div>
        <div class="wb-amount" data-amount="${data.amount}">${formatIDR(Math.floor(data.amount * 0.82))}</div>
        <div class="wb-game">${data.market} â€¢ Nomor ${data.number}</div>
        <div class="wb-type">${data.type}</div>
      </div>
    `;
    return li;
  }

  const LIST_SIZE = 8;
  for (let i = 0; i < LIST_SIZE; i++) {
    track.appendChild(renderItem(winner()));
  }

  function animateCount(el) {
    if (!el) return;
    const target = +el.dataset.amount;
    let start = Math.max(10000, Math.floor(target * 0.7));
    const dur = 650;
    const fps = 30;
    const step = Math.max(1, Math.floor((target - start) / (dur / (1000 / fps))));

    const timer = setInterval(() => {
      start += step;
      if (start >= target) {
        start = target;
        clearInterval(timer);
      }
      el.textContent = formatIDR(start);
    }, 1000 / fps);
  }

  function sprinkleCoins() {
    const n = rand(3, 6);
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      const s = document.createElement("span");
      s.className = "wb-coin";
      s.style.left = rand(20, board.offsetWidth - 20) + "px";
      s.style.bottom = rand(10, 40) + "px";
      s.style.setProperty("--sx", (Math.random() > 0.5 ? 1 : -1) * rand(6, 12) + "px");
      board.appendChild(s);
      setTimeout(() => s.remove(), 900);
    }
  }

  const STEP_MS = 2800;
  let ticking = false;

  function cycle() {
    if (ticking || track.children.length < 2) return;
    ticking = true;

    const first = track.children[0];
    const itemH = first.offsetHeight + 10;

    const upcoming = track.children[1];
    if (upcoming) upcoming.classList.add("is-new");

    track.style.transition = "transform .6s ease";
    track.style.transform = `translateY(-${itemH}px)`;

    track.addEventListener("transitionend", function onEnd() {
      track.removeEventListener("transitionend", onEnd);
      track.style.transition = "none";
      track.style.transform = "translateY(0)";

      track.appendChild(track.firstElementChild);

      [...track.children].forEach((li, i) => {
        li.classList.toggle("is-new", i === 0);
      });

      animateCount(track.children[0].querySelector("[data-amount]"));

      if (rand(0, 2) === 1) {
        const idx = rand(2, track.children.length - 1);
        track.replaceChild(renderItem(winner()), track.children[idx]);
      }

      sprinkleCoins();
      ticking = false;
    });
  }

  cycle();
  setInterval(cycle, STEP_MS);
});
</script>

	   <script>
         document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',
             function(){const faqItems=document.querySelectorAll('.faq-item');
             faqItems.forEach(item=>{const question=item.querySelector('.faq-question');
             question.addEventListener('click',
             ()=>{const isActive=item.classList.contains('active');
             faqItems.forEach(otherItem=>{otherItem.classList.remove('active')});
             if(!isActive){item.classList.add('active')}})})});

  <button class="cok-faq-q">Apa yang membuat NANA4D dikenal sebagai agen Toto 4D terbaik?</button>
  <div class="cok-faq-a">NANA4D menyediakan berbagai informasi pasaran lotto dalam satu platform dengan tampilan yang sederhana, akses ringan, serta menu yang mudah dipahami. Player dapat menemukan informasi pasaran lotto togel terbaik yang bisa dimainkan setiap harinya dengan aman dan menguntungkan.</div>
</div>

<div class="cok-faq-item">
  <button class="cok-faq-q">Pasaran lotto togel apa saja yang tersedia di NANA4D?</button>
  <div class="cok-faq-a">NANA4D menyediakan beberapa pilihan pasaran lotto dan togel 4D populer, antara lain Oregon Lottery, Carolina Day, Kynders Pools, serta Togel SGP. Ketersediaan setiap pasaran dapat berubah, sehingga player disarankan memeriksa jadwal dan ketentuan terbaru pada platform.</div>
</div>

<div class="cok-faq-item">
  <button class="cok-faq-q">Bagaimana proses transaksi di NANA4D?</button>
  <div class="cok-faq-a">Proses transaksi di NANA4D dirancang agar praktis dan transparan sesuai prosedur yang berlaku. Player perlu mengikuti ketentuan deposit, penarikan dana, verifikasi akun, dan batas transaksi yang tercantum. Lama pemrosesan dapat berbeda tergantung metode pembayaran dan hasil pemeriksaan akun.</div>
</div>

<div class="cok-faq-item">
  <button class="cok-faq-q">Apakah NANA4D menyediakan bonus cashback 10%?</button>
  <div class="cok-faq-a">NANA4D dapat menawarkan program promosi seperti cashback hingga 10% berdasarkan syarat dan ketentuan tertentu. Sebelum mengaktifkan bonus, player sebaiknya memeriksa minimal transaksi, periode promosi, batas maksimal bonus, serta aturan perputaran dana yang berlaku.</div>
</div>

<div class="cok-faq-item">
  <button class="cok-faq-q">Bagaimana cara bermain dengan lebih aman di NANA4D?</button>
  <div class="cok-faq-a">Gunakan dana hiburan yang sudah ditentukan sejak awal, pasang batas waktu dan nominal permainan, serta jangan mengejar kerugian. Permainan togel memiliki risiko kehilangan uang dan tidak menjamin kemenangan. Berhentilah bermain ketika batas dana tercapai dan gunakan fitur pembatasan akun apabila tersedia.</div>
</div>
